title: State and tactic pair
description: A proof state and the tactic that was run on it, taken from a smallest step of a proof: the goals before the tactic as one text, the tactic, and how many goals there were before and after. A tactic that leaves no goal closes the state. Pairs are taken only from proofs that are complete: a proof that rests on sorry, its own or that of a lemma it uses, gives none.
